An honest result.

—Price-only LR test AUC
—Combined minus price-only AUC
—Paired 95% interval

2,000 paired date-block bootstrap replicates. Five-session blocks, with one- and ten-session sensitivity. No model was refitted after freezing.

A zero interval here reflects identical predictions with missing sentiment, not proof that sentiment is useless.

What is frozen?

The model grids, selected settings, baselines, feature ordering, seed and evaluation plan are saved together. Changing a bound artifact blocks prediction.

The question remains open

The current run demonstrates the modeling pipeline using real prices. Without eligible news and Reddit history, it cannot test whether sentiment improves prediction.
